radiusSource: Radius 2.987 (2.925 to 3.049) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 2,078,089 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 2.048 (2.008 to 2.088) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 7603 +/- 6 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2840673506807375360: teff_gspphot 7602.5913 K (16th-84th percentiles 7596.5586-7608.508), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2840673506807375360: teff_gspphot 7602.5913 K (16th-84th percentiles 7596.5586-7608.508), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
